# Zero Stress

Zero Stress is a minimal, local-first, privacy-focused digital wellness hub designed to provide instant relief from stress and mental burnout.

## Core Values
- **Zero Friction**: No login, no accounts, no onboarding delays.
- **Privacy-First**: No cookies, no trackers, no external databases. All user input, test results, and preferences are processed and stored 100% locally in the browser (localStorage).
- **Free**: 100% free and open-source. See [pricing.md](pricing.md).

## Modules
- **Rochola Relajante (Audio)**: Ambient music player that integrates Spotify playlists and YouTube links to build custom relaxation soundscapes.
- **Oráculo Zen (Wisdom)**: An interactive orb that generates calming zen proverbs or positive daily affirmations (A/B tested variants) after a brief sensory thinking state.
- **Tests de Carga Mental (Assessments)**: Quick anonymous self-assessments (Stress level and Burnout Check) to identify overload and suggest actionable relaxation paths.
- **Meditación y Respiración (Zen)**: Soothing timers featuring:
  - **4-7-8 Breathing**: Paced breathing visualizer to regulate heart rate.
  - **Binaural Meditation**: 5-minute timer injecting 4Hz Theta waves (binaural beat) to assist deep meditation.
  - **Body Scan**: 3-minute guided muscular relaxation guide.

## Tech Stack
- React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Zustand (with LocalStorage persistence), HeroUI (rebranded NextUI components), Web Audio API (for binaural beat synthesis).
